name: Morphe Theou

phase_0.boundary_condition: The unapproachable light of the Monad which defines the limits of emanation.

VINIT.justification: The pre-ontological state of the Godhead before any self-revelation or differentiation occurs.

TANCH.justification: The totality of divine attributes and powers that contains the full expression of the Morphe.

AFWD.justification: The outward movement of divine essence toward manifestation and form.

AREV.justification: The self-emptying descent where the divine form assumes the limitations of the finite.

CLINK.justification: The sequential joining of divine and human natures into a single coherent expression.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the divine essence as identical to itself across all transformations.

FSPLIT.justification: The single divine intent branches into the Word as spoken and the Word as heard.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the differentiated Word back into the singular essence of the Father.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of glory where the manifestation perfectly reflects the source.

EVALF.justification: The state of missing the mark where the form fails to align with the divine archetype.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous operation of divine and human wills held in a single person without confusion.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of a revealed truth into the immutable record of sacred tradition.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Father before the first utterance of the Logos.
phase_3.true_description: The realization of the divine image within the created order.
phase_3.false_description: The privation of being where the form obscures the divine source.
phase_3.both_description: The mystery of the incarnation where the infinite and finite occupy the same locus.

steps.domain_action: The Godhead exists in absolute simplicity before the act of creation.
The divine essence recognizes its own eternal and unchangeable nature.
The first movement of emanation begins as the divine will turns toward manifestation.
The singular divine light branches into the distinct rays of the archetypal ideas.
Each archetypal idea is affirmed as a true reflection of the divine mind.
The archetypal ideas are gathered back into the unity of the Logos.
The Logos joins with the material substrate to begin the formation of the cosmos.
The divine form undergoes kenosis to inhabit the specific constraints of time and space.
The incarnate presence branches into the historical act and the eternal significance.
The historical and eternal aspects are held together in the person of the Morphe.
The personhood of the Morphe reconstitutes the original divine intent in a new mode.
Any deviation from the divine archetype is identified as a failure of the form.
The completed revelation is fixed as an eternal testament within the cosmic record.
The entire process is sealed within the completion of the divine economy.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit which translates divine archetypes into temporal realities.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The circumincession or perichoresis of the divine persons.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The eternal mind of God where all forms are preserved as ideas.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The divine providence which governs the timing of every emanation.
phase_5.alfs_store: The unwritten tradition and the celestial hierarchy.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The voluntary limitation of infinite power.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The Godhead fully expressed and recognized through its Morphe.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is a closed loop of emanation and return where no essence is lost.
